info.title: Vixir API
info.description:
REST API for Vixir, the open-source virtual practical laboratory.

**Authentication.** Obtain an access token from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (or `/register`, `/google`)
and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The refresh token is set as the httpOnly cookie
`vx_refresh` (path `/api/v1/auth/refresh`); call `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` to rotate both.

**Errors** use RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`) with an extra `code` property.
Resources the caller may not access return **404**, not 403, so their existence is not revealed.

**Internal endpoints** (`/api/v1/internal/**`) are for the Vix agent only and take a service JWT
signed with `VIXIR_SERVICE_SECRET` with `scope=vix-agent`.

post.description: Send assignmentId to start or resume a graded attempt, or experimentId for free practice. Returns the seed and experiment config; for a resumed attempt, also the events logged so far.
Returns 202 at once; marking runs in the background. Send an Idempotency-Key header so retries do not create duplicate submissions. Own attempts only.

get.description: For resume and bench replay. Pass afterSeq to fetch only newer events. Own attempts only.

post.summary: Upload a batch of attempt events
post.description: Up to 200 events per batch. Idempotent by clientEventId, so offline sync can retry safely; duplicates are reported, not stored again. Own attempts only.
Public (landing page). Sets or reads the httpOnly vx_anon cookie that identifies the anonymous user.
